summary: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce an equity distribution agreement with Noble Capital Markets to sell up to $5.235810 million of Class A common stock in an at-the-market offering. Sales will depend on market conditions and capital needs, conducted via ordinary brokers' transactions on Nasdaq at prevailing prices. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an effective registration statement, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms beyond standard mechanics. This is ordinary financing activity, not an event-driven transaction to watch.
